status: future work; no calibrated voltage/current sensing has been performed

recommended_architecture.voltage_sensor: isolated low-voltage AC-AC adapter or certified isolated voltage transducer
recommended_architecture.current_sensor: split-core current transformer with correctly designed burden and protection
recommended_architecture.adc: two-channel simultaneous-sampling external ADC such as ADS131M02 on a reviewed PCB/evaluation platform
recommended_architecture.reference: calibrated power/energy analyzer with documented accuracy
recommended_architecture.output: timestamped Vrms, Irms, real power, apparent power, power factor, and integrated energy

reasons_not_to_use_a0_as_primary_meter: bare-chip external input range is 0 to 1.0 V
Espressif warns that Wi-Fi/current-state changes can affect ADC behavior
voltage and current cannot be sampled simultaneously

recommended_sampling.sample_rate_per_channel: 4 kSPS initial target for 50 Hz evaluation
recommended_sampling.forecast_aggregation: 30-minute energy intervals to match the present model contract
recommended_sampling.quantized_buffer_option: store normalized 30-minute values in Q15 form if the Phase 14 fixed-point path is later adopted

validation_stages: phase calibration using resistive and reactive loads
multi-day 30-minute aggregation and live lag-buffer validation
qualified mains field trial only after enclosure and safety review
required_results_before_claiming_a_smart: edge/cloud prediction agreement on newly collected data
physically verified event annotations for anomaly evaluation

safety.ct_warning: Never leave a current-output CT secondary open-circuit while clamped around an energized conductor.
